INSERT INTO streams (streamerId, title, description, category, streamKey, isLive, hlsUrl, thumbnailUrl, viewerCount, startedAt)
SELECT 
  id as streamerId,
  'Test Gaming Stream - PROUDY.TV OG Image Demo' as title,
  'Testing Open Graph image generation with dynamic canvas rendering. This stream showcases the new OG image feature!' as description,
  'Gaming' as category,
  CONCAT('test-', UUID()) as streamKey,
  1 as isLive,
  'https://test-streams.mux.dev/x36xhzz/x36xhzz.m3u8' as hlsUrl,
  'https://image.mux.com/x36xhzz/thumbnail.jpg' as thumbnailUrl,
  42 as viewerCount,
  NOW() as startedAt
FROM users 
WHERE role IN ('admin', 'streamer')
LIMIT 1;

SELECT id, title, category, viewerCount FROM streams ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
